lines.text: You already said the words.
You already chose to forgive.
But something in you still flinches when the memory comes back.
You smile when their name is mentioned.
Yet your chest tightens.
You say you've moved on.
But your body still remembers the wound.
This is not a prayer to pretend it never hurt.
This is not a prayer to reopen the door.
This is a prayer to finally lay the debt down.
Tonight, I release what was never mine to carry.
I cancel the claim.
I close the account.
I will not keep revisiting what God has already settled.
I will not keep bleeding where He has already spoken healing.
I will not confuse forgiveness with access.
I forgive.
I release.
And I refuse to reopen what heaven has closed.
The door stays shut.
The debt is cancelled.
And my peace is no longer up for negotiation.
In Jesus' name.

title: Word and Faith Network
subtitle: Release the debt. Keep the boundary.
